categories.label: Literature sources
categories.description: Top-level entity representing one publication, report, thesis, dataset, or experimental campaign.

categories.label: Keywords
categories.description: Searchable descriptors associated with the source or dataset.

categories.label: Material batches
categories.description: Material mixture, batch, or material system definition.

categories.label: Geometries
categories.description: Reusable specimen geometry definition based on the geometry parametrization library.

categories.label: Reinforcement materials
categories.description: Reusable definition of properties for reinforcement materials.

categories.label: Reinforcement layouts
categories.description: Reusable definition of a reinforcement layout associated with a specimen geometry. Combines multiple reinforcement components into a complete reinforcement configuration defined with respect to the coordinate system and geometric parametrization of the associated specimen geometry.

categories.label: Reinforcement components
categories.description: Reusable definition of reinforcement components. Represents one reinforcement component, e.g., rebar layer, stirrup set, tie set, or external reinforcement system, associated with a reinforcement layout. Combines reinforcement geometrical information and material properties to define one component of a reinforcement layout.

categories.label: Specimens
categories.description: Intermediate entity representing a physical specimen or specimen family defined by the combination of material batch, geometry, optional reinforcement, and optional printing variables.

categories.label: Tests
categories.description: Experimental test performed on a specimen.

categories.label: Devices and supports
categories.description: Support, actuator, sensor, fixture, instrumentation component, or measurement device associated with a test.

categories.label: Loading histories
categories.description: Loading protocol or loading time history associated with a test and, when applicable, with a device.

categories.label: Data
categories.description: Experimental observation or dataset, including scalar quantities, curves, tables, images, videos, and multidimensional fields.
